notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup from product tour (marketing landing). Product: in-app conversational assistant embedded in their B2B SaaS UX (customer success + inline help).

Key priorities (customer quotes + paraphrase):
- "chat must feel instant" (CEO) — low-latency streaming is top priority; user experience degrades with >150ms perceived lag.
- Need websocket/streaming support and chunked deltas to render UI progressively.
- POC success metrics: median per-token latency <50ms at typical session sizes (1-3 agents), p95 end-to-end <200ms, startup latency (first-byte) <120ms.
- Throughput expectations small-to-medium: 20-60 concurrent active users, bursts to ~120. Expect peak ~40 reqs/s during business hours.

Model & runtime preferences:
- Prefer hosted API for speed to market; open to quantized Llama-like models to reduce cost, but want Redwood-managed variants.
- Need function/tool calling (to hit internal APIs for account lookup) and stable conversation state (they'll manage long convo state in Redis).
- Fallback plan: smaller model variant when latency or capacity constrained. Want policy-based routing (latency-first).

Security & compliance:
- Company is pre-SOC2; needs SSO (SAML) and audit logs for access/usage. Data residency: US only. Data retention policy: 30 days default; can request shorter for sensitive records.

Cost sensitivity:
- Early-stage budget-conscious. Target unit economics: keep per-message cost low; initial ARR estimate $5k-$20k. POC budget limited; asked for trial credits.

POC definition & metrics:
- 2-week POC using Redwood Hosted API. Redwood provides 100K token credits and sample streaming frontend (React + websocket).
- Success = integrate streaming SDK, meet median latency <50ms for interactive sessions, and validate cost projections.

Quotes & quick notes:
- CEO: 'Users bail if responses feel slow — we need 95th percentile snappy.'
- PM: 'Want an example of prefix/KV cache usage to avoid re-tokenizing long histories.'

Open questions for Redwood:
- Can we enable per-route streaming config and quick canary to smaller model fallback?
- Any sample dashboards for token-level cost per route?
- Clarify SSO integration steps and audit-log export for their SIEM.

Next steps (agreed):
1) AE Sofia to send trial promo + pricing anchor and security FAQ (drive://decks/lumenleaf-redwood-trial-20260303.pdf).
2) SE Derek to ship React streaming example + small checklist for websocket integration before POC start.
3) Schedule 60-min POC kickoff meeting (target 2026-03-17).
